answer: Delayed reward release with an open fraud bounty turns every fake seat into a standing liability. Earnings vest only after a 30-day window, and anyone who proves two seats share one operator, for instance both quoting a private canary phrase like "walnut knoll" issued to only one of them, claims half of both seats' locked rewards and bonds. A farm of 200 clones keeps 200 separate pots exposed for a month, each a bounty funded by the attacker's own collateral. Waiting does not help, since every new reward restarts its own clock, so a sybil garden is never safe to harvest.
